source_usage: Source files are preserved evidence of the episode, not automatic runtime scripts. Their product names, rankings, exact positions and timestamps are not the reusable API.

user_authorization.reference: Current conversation: user approves the ten-agent episode motion, color and material quality, asks to upgrade using its production approach and actual source while retaining the entire effects library.
user_authorization.opening: With a presenter opening source, preserve the complete original scene and constrain effects to measured clear areas. Without that source, an authored UI opening may be used.
user_authorization.body: Left presenter/section area and right content are a baseline composition; focus can occupy full stage, then return when content calls for it.
user_authorization.adaptation: Every new narration requires new event/content/asset/layout design; no fixed ranking, product list or opening timings.

extraction_map.adaptation: Exact six-color palette; drawing helpers parameterized by context, viewport, material and font; product logo/ranking functions not generalized.
Physical offset backs, edge weight, neutral material surfaces, accent purple, bold type and causal progress marks exposed as parameterized drawing; no product-specific labels or timelines.
Original dependency-free deterministic motion implementation copied byte-for-byte at module root; not claimed to be AE or original-author Adobe source.
Quartic acceleration/deceleration, delayed spring landings and rectangular handoff geometry expose timing and geometry parameters.
Narration-cue-driven absolute timing; unknown cue fails clearly rather than silently activating at chapter start.

New reusable measured-region protection derived from original complete-scene presenter and content clipping. Disjoint actual Canvas clip subtracts presenter/gesture/subtitle rectangles. No automatic person detector is claimed. Opening draws complete original frame first; missing protection prevents effects from drawing.
New generic viewport/layout wrappers allow caller-specified body and full-focus regions. No episode sidebar width or right-side opening coordinate is forced.
